english: A dark iron can of a man sits alone on the temple steps.
His face obscured, an axe strapped to his back.
Thick axe. Heavy.
This is a real man. A hero.
His armor is empty.
As is his heart.
Citizen.
I have some questions, good knight.
Are you alive?
His helmed head is slumped downwards, slightly.
Is he... asleep?
He is not really here.
Just stare at him.
Hello?
Are you okay, citizen?
No response.
Wait.
Hello-oo?
My good knight, say something!
A metallic scraping noise fills your ears.
The knight is moving, ever so slightly. His head turns.
Oh fuck.
Within the slits of his helmet, you see the faint shimmer of a bony face.
Your... name.
Soldier.
His voice echoes out into the open chamber.
Pure dread.
This is a great warrior. Treat him with respect.
What is wrong with you?
I am Ragn.
Arcane Cleric. At your service, my lord.
I'm not a soldier.
He does not respond to your inquiry.
You hear the knight clenching his iron gauntlet.
No. You are.
What, does he want to fight?
The knight's head slumps once again.
Speak your mind, soldier.
The iron tin can knight man dude does not acknowledge your presence.
He's ready for more of your questions.
Who are you?
Why are you loitering here, knight?
Whom do you serve?
What do you know about the tea shop?
What's up with the mess? (Point at the ballot boxes.)
E-"Citizen."
He is silent for a while.
You feel a light breeze pass through your armor.
A draft? Perhaps there's a secret door here somewhere.
No wait, it's probably from the tea door hatch.
The Duck.
Excuse me?
I am The Duck.
That's wild.
A man's name is not up to debate.
Quack.
Horrifying.
(Nod.) "You should be proud of your name."
That doesn't suit you at all.
Quack! (Laugh.)
The knight does not respond.
This name of his is a codename, surely.
He does not wish to share more.
No.
I see. I'm looking for Lord Gorm. Have you seen him?
Are you lying to me?
Damn. Was hoping you would be.
A truth.
The knight doesn't move.
No.
That's what a liar would say.
Okay. Good. I believe you.
Cease this inquiry.
You're annoying him.
Yeah. Keep at it, maybe he'll kick your ass.
You're walking into a dangerous situation.
Actually, you're already in it. So... stop.
Sorry.
This is my job. I'm just doing my job.
Let me ask something else.
IT IS WHAT MY CHARACTER WOULD DO.
His helmed head turns, facing yours.
Sorry. (Speak in a high-pitched tone.)
I have some other questions. (Speak in a slightly less high-pitched tone.)
For whatever reason, he does not appear hostile to you. Even when there's clearly deadly intent in his soul.
Has this guy been, like, told not to hurt you? Why else would he not give you a love tap at this point?
Love tap? Disgusting language.
It's called a manly wrestle! Or a fisting!
Don't call it that. Please.
Crypts.
He doesn't seem too mad about you taking the key. Strange.
I have the key.
You are too weak for that.
Who's he to judge you?
The man is correct. You need to get back to your strength first.
The City Below is dangerous. You should make sure to prepare properly before heading down there.
Perhaps bring more spells. Perhaps make sure to recuperate enough for you to once again be able to cast higher tier spells.
It is embarrassing you have not already returned to your former state of esoteric mastery.
He does not respond for a while.
Then he simply throws you the key.
He recognizes your strength.
Why? He's clearly stronger than you. He could have just said no.
The City Below... it is darkness incarnate.
Do not tread without care.
You never do.
A warning from someone with ages upon him.
Heed the call, from BEYOND the grave.
The knight sits completely still and does not answer your question.
Come on. I won't tell anyone.
I think you're amazing, my good knight.
Got it. (Get it.)
This creature holds no grudges, yet his hollow disposition taunts your senses.
You feel invalid next to this man. You must learn from his ways.
Attempt to have a firm discussion about masculinity.
BorgoAnnoyed-You've_annoyed_him.
(Drop it.)
The knight sits still.
Is he even breathing?
No breath. Only death.
He just sits there, ready for a good talk.
You catch something. A glimpse of light within the darkness of his helmet.
Divinity. There's light within this man.
(Stare at him.)
The knight shifts slightly, his armor scraping against the rock.
(Breathe heavily.)
The knight turns to look at you through his helmet.
A little more.
(Wait a bit longer.)
Soldier. Your presence is unwanted.
Present your query, then leave these hallowed grounds.
He'll answer your questions now. Somehow.
Are you a cleric?
Do you know magic?
Can you teach me magic?
M-"How does one become a true warrior?"
No, he says. "I am a warrior."
Yes.
No, I-
He mutters to himself.
Oh?
I do not have time for that.
The knight slowly grabs a scroll out of his pack.
He tosses it to you after a moment of deliberation.
A spell with power.
Memorize it, soldier.
Already did. (Close the spell scroll.)
He lifts his head. The darkness through his helmet focuses on you.
No, soldier. Memorize it.
I told you, I already did. (Point at your temple.) "I'm quick."
You...
The Cleric here is a bit of a monster when it comes to magic, from what I understand.
The dark knight nods, and then lowers his head.
You've earned his respect. Good.
Your ability to memorize spells instantly is an incredible talent. He should be impressed.
A warrior.
The knight places an iron gauntlet upon his knee and leans forward.
A whispering wheeze escapes the slits in his helmet.
SERVE.
Until the Coast falls in on itself. Until JOR breaks the veil and every god rips and tears our reality into shreds.
Serve well. Serve loyally.
That is what a true warrior does. No matter what.
The wheezing stops.
Your companion gives you a horrified glance.
What if you serve someone evil?
Yes. I will serve. No matter what.
Right. Thanks.
He shakes his head, slowly.
Place not the choice of morality into the hand of the one who swings the axe.
Truth of alignment lies entirely with your god, soldier.
Do not forget that.
Good.
He nods, slowly. "Good."
He nods, slowly.
He lifts his hand and clenches it.
Now, quick! Ask him while he's got his guard down!
Oh. An opening! Go for it.
Wait, who do you serve again?
Visken.
He moves his head towards you.
No. That is not.
Visken? The mortician?
With a sudden force, the dark knight slams his axe into the ground.
Darkness creeps through the hall.
Within <shake>you</shake>.
Do not speak of that, soldier.
I won't tell anyone.
Why? Is it a secret?
(Just nod.)
He returns to his still position.
Do not.
The knight is now waiting for another question. Lucky you, he didn't kill you!
You feel anger rising.
Aggression.
Yes, that is the only way to ever live up to this ideal of a man in front of you.
Your goblin companion takes a step back as he notices your shaking fists.
Man, the architecture in this temple is amazing.
I'll... be over here if you need me.
(Step towards the dark knight.) "D-DO YOU KNOW WHO I AM?"
I... I... (Try to contain yourself, as well as your bulging masculine power.)
He does not answer you.
He does not even look at you.
My... MY NAME... WILL GO DOWN... THROUGH THE ANALS OF HISTORY...! (Stand straight.)
The w-what?!
That's right!
The goblin, who now stands a number of steps behind you, lets out a shocked laugh.
The WHAT? he exclaims, almost keeling over.
The knight lifts his head, facing you.
Chills.
Uh...
Annals.
It is annals, soldier.
Ah. Right, thanks. What did I say?
No it's not.
You hear a deep, groaning appear from the dark armor, like a wind blowing over an ancient haunted house.
Right. Uh...
There is no choice now. It is time.
Or...
You could talk with him and learn without the use of mindless violence.
You must show what you're made of - through overwhelming masculine force.
As your eyes land upon the dark knight, you feel an overwhelming need to surrender.
I must fight him. (Begin encounter.)
I must destroy him. (Begin encounter.)
I must kill him. (Begin encounter.)
Fuck this. (Surrender.)
I must... talk things out. (Be boring.)
You go down on one knee.
This is where you belong. Below stronger men.
I formally surrender my body and soul to you, oh great masculine man.
The knight does not respond at first.
But as you remain on your knee in silence for a while, eventually he says a word to you.
Cease.
As you command, my lord.
He does not respond. Instead, he simply goes quiet once more.
This is... for the best.
This is... embarrassing.
I am not.
The cold voice echoes throughout the chamber.
I disagree.
What are you doing then?
I am on my off-hours.
He speaks as though he's reading from a script.
Just sitting here? In the temple?
You... like it here?
(Squint and glare at him.) "You Urthfolk?"
I don't like you hanging around here.
This is a holy place. Leave.
Just don't cause any trouble.
I, too, would like to hang on the steps of the temple.
His helmet turns slightly.
Scary.
But I don't have time. I'm busy.
But I won't force you to hang out with me.
Can I hang out with you? Please?
His helmet turns away.
Some metallic creaking is all you hear from the knight.
Your manhood is infinitely tiny in comparison.
Serve this man.
I serve... he says, trailing off.
For a split second you could swear... a spark appearing within the armor.
Radiant.
Yes?
Once again he turns to look at you, the darkness within his helmet seeming to reach out towards you.
As if grabbing hold of the very air, you feel everything growing cold.
As if grabbing hold of the very air, you feel everything growing cold. His dark soul is reaching out.
This creature before you is neither human nor alive.
I serve nothing.
A lie and a truth, at once.
Not much.
He'll talk? Why? Not like you can threaten him exactly.
Where were you at noon on the 21st?
Did you see anything suspicious before the explosion?
Now... some other... questions.
Below.
Okay. Below. Can you elaborate?
I need more than that, my good knight.
The walls shook in the crypts. I was on patrol.
I was not in position to perceive any misdoings.
There are thousands of tombs and crypts scattered below this ancient metropolis.
The City Below is endless and most of it stands unexplored to this day.
Okay. Sure. Why were you in the crypts?
Wait. What are you patrolling for?
He is silent and still for a moment.
I have my purpose.
As do you, soldier. Do not pry too deep.
Are you threatening me?
Noted.
He places an iron hand on his knee, waiting for the next question.
That is a firm, yet gentle reminder that he could crush you in an instant.
Well then.
You sure?
Got it.
The knight nods, slowly.
He goes silent for a while.
A man passed through the halls below.
Civilians do not pass there.
Past the crypt entrance. Through the Goblin's domain. Into the Southern Caverns.
That's the flip caverns, where gravity is reversed. Below the city ruins.
A man?
What's past the crypts?
How do I get to the City Below?
So basically, dive deep like some spelunker?
This is great. Thank you, my good knight.
Dark hair. Silk clothes. Headwear.
Dressed in yellow.
Sounds like a Reedsian nobility-merchant type.
The Roots of the Goblin's Tree.
Then more tunnels. The southern tunnels.
Then the sewers.
How do I get there?
There are paths. Most are trapped.
Once you get there, the Alligator might know more. His grounds are near.
You've heard rumors of monsters in the sewers under Waterlane...
Yeah. Don't look for an alligator under the city. Sounds stupid.
His rage is endless. His appetite growing.
You have delved deep.
Do not anger him.
He won't speak more about this horrific creature.
The knight looks down, waiting for your next question.
He pauses, as if thinking about your question. "The goblins."
Use their passage. Below Visken's Lair.
Right. The staircase by the apples. Where you woke up.
There are many ways down. But the passage in the chamber where you woke up... that would be a good place.
That is the safest path.
Might be some neat treasure down there...
He is quiet.
Has he been ordered to answer your questions? This feels forced.
He likes you.
The dark knight sits still on the steps.
Without lifting his head, the knight answers in a cold tone.
Election.
Ah. So this is where it's being held.
What are you voting for, my good knight?
Other... questions?
No reply.
I'll be voting Nationalist.
I'm voting for the Freestriders.
I'm going to vote for Azgalism.
Everyone should vote for me, ideally.
(Just be Agrarian. Don't even say anything. It's not like they have any chance of winning anyway.)
I'm actually apolitical. Isn't that interesting?
I hate elections.
The knight doesn't even move.
He does not care for your political opinions. How manly.
It stirs. His silence tells you nothing of life.
Nor the human-ish experience.
In a swift move, the dark knight wraps your wrist in a cold embrace.
You hear a cracking sound as he squeezes hard around it.
Ah! Ah! I'm sorry!
Release me, good knight!
Say nothing. Just take it.
He lets go of your wrist.
Saying nothing, he just turns back to looking into nothing.
E-Ouch.
You take a step towards your target.
The knight does not appear to react.
What are you doing?
I hope you're well aware that I am not going to-
IGNORE THE GOBLIN.
THIS IS WAR.
Roll initiative.
The knight moves slightly, sending an echo of metal through the chamber.
This is an amazingly terrible idea.
Silence, coward!
Well, you've managed to be quicker than this tin can. Not sure how it'll help, though.
Holy shit, this guy is fast. You're fucking dead!
He does not raise a hand towards you.
Yet you see the scurrying of shadows in the corner of your vision.
Your soul. It's laid bare.
Feeling an immense and unbearable pain start to take hold, your knees grow weak.
He's casting a spell!
(Grunt.)
(Grit your teeth.)
(Scream.)
Your body convulses as the shadows wrap themselves around your being.
A chunk of your being is ripped from the stem.
You don't see anything.
You only see the outline of a knight in front of you.
As the connection snaps.
The dark knight is sitting on the stairs in front of you, as if nothing happened.
Your breathing is unsteady.
Legs trembling.
How the hell are you still standing?
I'm not... done yet. (Cough up blood.)
Can I give up now? (Also cough up blood.)
What the hell are you going to do?
The only thing you can.
Fight.
Punch him in the face.
Will you be my father? I mean, my master?
You swing your fist and connect.
A hard surface greets your knuckles, a breaking seems to occur yet you feel no pain.
Yet.
The metallic crash of iron against hard stone echoes as the massive knight is pushed back, back and down.
Down onto the steps.
You take a breath, realizing you've held it for a number of seconds now.
The echo fades.
The knight slowly and deliberately rises back into seated position on the stairs.
Oh gods.
You swing your fist and hit hard plate armor.
A hard surface greets your knuckles, cracking them.
Immediately, the dark knight grabs your entire head and helm with a single fist.
CEASE.
He tosses you aside.
(Scramble to get up.)
He sits down once again, as if nothing happened.
As the words leave your mouth, you feel the tingling sensation of the universe pulling your lips apart.
The air blown through your throat is hot, yet empty.
It sparkles.
What? Where am I?
You're standing in front of a dark knight, asking him to be your father.
Since you've lost so many.
Why would I do that? That's weird.
Do not worry. He will come back to you.
One of these days.
The knight has seated himself back upon the steps.
Your god has your service.
Keep that close. Do not falter.
And do not say such foolish, disgusting things.
...Okay.
The knight stops, and actually turns his helmed head to look at you.
You heard me. (Bow down your head.)
What is wrong with you, soldier?
He sits down again, seemingly losing all aggression.
He turns to you.
The knight seems to accept this as the end of the encounter.
He sees you pose no threat at this state.
